intro.text: The Payment Service Initiation capabilities allow customers to authorise payments at their LFI which a TPP then submits within the bounds of that authorisation. Payment types range from one-time instant payments through to long-running multi-payment consents with variable amounts, schedules, or delegated authentication.

blocks.text: Access to the Payment Service Initiation APIs requires TPPs to hold the BSIP role. The API Hub validates the role on every request before proxying it to the LFI. If the consent also includes data-sharing permissions ( ReadAccountsBasic, ReadAccountsDetail, ReadBalances ), TPPs additionally require the BDSP role.
